column5: GROUP: **q, rc (12)** | - rc:4818-4820 no storage index means "no atomic storage", which disables the qualification-erasure check.
GROUP: **q, rc (12)** | - rc:1028-1050 with rc:4660 non-`Domain` constraints give `None`, read as "no qualification issue"; an `ArithmeticDomain` constraint is ignored.
GROUP: **rrc, scc, tr (13)** | - rrc:3354-3356 with rrc:4516-4535 `Image` sources count as not present so the leaf needs no loan; reader: "none identified for ordinary programs".
GROUP: **rrc, scc, tr (13)** | - rrc:8795-8799 invocation-rooted sources accepted without comparing any argument.
GROUP: **rrc, scc, tr (13)** | - rrc:7020-7022 — "a boundary/opaque data value that stores a reference would then not be a 'reference record'".
GROUP: **rrc, scc, tr (13)** | - rrc:7685-7687, 7742-7747 `NumericOwned` contents and activation byte carriers count as holding no references.
